blocks.name: Setup
blocks.note: Repo, CONTEXT.md, friend added as collaborator, widget live

blocks.name: Capture
blocks.note: Room walk-around (1x lens, locked exposure, tilt-up for ceiling). 10 side-view jump shots, all logged

blocks.name: Modal: upload + splat job
blocks.note: Clips to Modal Volume. Start room splat training

blocks.name: Lunch + ball keyframes
blocks.note: Pick the best side-view clip. Click 5 to 10 ball keyframes by hand

blocks.name: Viewer v0
blocks.note: Static splat renders in the browser with orbit controls

blocks.name: Pose run
blocks.note: GVHMR on the chosen clip (needs SMPL files). Export skeleton JSON

blocks.name: Place the shot
blocks.note: 4-point floor alignment. Skeleton and ball trail inside the splat

blocks.name: Dinner + go/no-go
blocks.note: Placement looks right: keep going. If not: billboard cutout of the jump

blocks.name: Camera path
blocks.note: Keyframed 30 to 40 degree arc. Raw clip next to the output

blocks.name: First full render
blocks.note: Screen-record the viewer. Write the cut list

blocks.name: Overnight shifts
blocks.note: Batch renders run on Modal. Swap shifts at 03:00

blocks.name: Overnight shift B
blocks.note: Fix, re-render. Batch renders keep running

blocks.name: Overnight shift A
blocks.note: Fix, re-render. Scope freeze is at 06:00

blocks.name: Freeze + pick render
blocks.note: No new features after 06:00

blocks.name: Video script
blocks.note: 3:00 cut: hook, REAL vs RENDERED labels, impact line, end card

blocks.name: RECORD (90 min block)
blocks.note: Screen capture + narration. Target a 3:00 final

blocks.name: Export + submit
blocks.note: Upload, then confirm the submission went through

blocks.name: Buffer
blocks.note: No changes after 09:30

blocks.name: Hacking ends
blocks.note: Stop committing

blocks.name: Judging
blocks.note: Live discussion. Pitch: shot-form review, then the replay
